page_title: Android File Transfer for Mac | Quick Share | Nearby Drop

sources.entry: Nearby Drop - Independent macOS menu-bar app for two-way Google Quick Share transfers with compatible Android devices, plus USB MTP, Finder sharing, QR tools, and experimental Windows interoperability. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Nearby Drop
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu-bar app for sending files between a Mac and Android phones via Google Quick Share over Wi-Fi, plus USB MTP file browsing, Finder sharing and QR tools.
keywords: send files from finder to android
use_cases: Send photos from a Mac to an Android phone over Wi-Fi
Receive Quick Share files from an Android phone on a Mac
Browse and copy Android phone files over a USB cable
Share files or links from Finder to an Android device
Transfer files between Windows PCs and a Mac via Quick Share (experimental)
summary.what_it_does: Nearby Drop is a menu-bar app for macOS 14 or later that sends files from a Mac to Android and receives them on the Mac using Google Quick Share over a shared local Wi-Fi network, with a PIN confirmation step. It includes a USB MTP file browser for browsing, uploading and downloading Android files over a data cable. A Finder Share Extension lets users send files, folders or links from Finder. The app also offers in-app QR codes for Mac-to-Android sending and camera scanning of Android QR codes for receiving, and an experimental Windows Quick Share interoperability mode. The page lists transfer progress, cancel, history, device name, download folder and trusted-device settings.
notable: Two-way Quick Share transfers between Mac and Android over local Wi-Fi
USB MTP file browser for Android in the same app
Experimental Windows Quick Share interoperability, tested with one PC
caveats: Quick Share discovery depends on device model, network and reachable local Wi-Fi; LTE-only phone hotspot discovery is not verified
Windows testing is limited to one PC and the packaged release was not separately device-tested
macOS may show a 'cannot be checked for malicious software' warning
